maddeler.e:
نرتجي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَجِي (nartajī) /nar.ta.d͡ʒiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# نَرْتَجِيَ (nartajiya) /nar.ta.d͡ʒi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
